english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a type or category, including 一種 + N for “a kind of N.”
This is the all-purpose choice for a kind, sort, or category.
Use 種 as the everyday all-purpose noun for a type or kind.
Use this for a sort or kind, especially in expressions such as 「呢種人」.
Use 種 when brand means a particular type, variety, or manner, as in a particular kind of flattery.

english.note: Use 種 as the shorter taxonomic label when discussing species as a rank in biological classification.

examples.english: In biological classification, species is a rank below genus.
